d: The role of a lead raider in a kabaddi team is to do the bulk of the scoring and more often than not it’s the performance of the side’s go-to raider that makes the difference between a win or loss. In this throwback video, we take a look at some of the raiders who scored the most raid points in a Pro Kabaddi match. For more such videos, visit our website prokabaddi.com, YouTube channel, and the Official Pro Kabaddi App!
